notes: Runway and taxiway centerlines use LineString geometry; parking positions use Point geometry, matching the supplied example.
Mapped coordinates and aircraft stand stop positions are approximate. For simulation use.

Runways are ordered from the first named runway end toward the second. Published runway-end coordinates were applied to all three runways. Connected mapped taxiway vertices were carried to the adjusted centerlines. The Runway 10 western endpoint was trimmed to remove the mapped EMAS extension.
Pattern altitude is 2000 feet MSL for multi-engine/turboprop/jet aircraft. Single-engine pattern altitude is approximately 1400 feet MSL.

Runway 10/28 threshold offsets are 298 and 600 feet respectively. PatternSize, holdShortDistance and noTurnoff are omitted to use airport defaults; runway turnoff is configured toward the parallel taxiway.
F1/F2, P, B, D and L labels on otherwise unnamed or mislabelled mapped segments were interpreted from the FAA diagram.
APRON_GA_1, APRON_GA_2, APRON_CARGO_1, RUNUP_A and GA1 are descriptive identifiers, not published taxiway or stand designations.
Parking headings are omitted when unknown. De-ice Pad T is omitted because it is not a normal parking stand.

Added 12 approximate GA parking positions GAN1–GAN12 on the northwestern 100 Ramp, plus 24 positions GAS1–GAS24 across southern GA ramps. These are illustrative simulation positions, not surveyed or published stand designations. Placement is inside mapped aprons, outside mapped buildings and at least 18 metres from mapped runway, taxiway and taxilane centerlines.

Consolidated each named taxiway into one connected LineString for importers that select one feature per name. Branches use repeated existing segments to preserve the full network without artificial shortcuts. The disconnected mapped H fork north of Runway 10/28 was grouped with L, which it joins between the runway and B.

Parking retains original gate and cargo identifiers. Feature names are unique within each feature type; ATCTrainer parking destinations use @ prefixes, for example @A6. Null parking headings are omitted. Runway patternAltitude is numeric and primary turnoff is right toward parallel taxiways A, F and H.

Removed retracing walks from branched taxiway LineStrings. The main line retains its taxiway name; secondary geometry uses NAME_LINKn simulator connector identifiers, which are not charted taxiway designations. All original undirected segments and parking features are preserved.

Added integer parking headings at all 26 passenger terminal gate positions A/B, aiming toward the nearest wall of the corresponding OSM concourse. Headings are geometric approximations, not surveyed stand guidance bearings.
